resume: A prank instrument: ten real recorded noises (CC0), reverb, delay and a 16-step loop. The 27 keys play the samples, and you record a one-bar loop.

commandes.role: Starts the loop from step 1, or stops playback and recording while keeping the loop.
One press: starts recording from step 1 when stopped, or turns overdub on and off during playback. Held one second: erases the whole loop.
Tempo, from 40 to 240 BPM, one BPM per notch; starts at 120.
The 27 keys each play a full sample, ten sounds repeated across the keyboard.

gestes: REC held one second: erases the loop.
a_savoir: The loop lives in memory only: turning the FM-1 off erases it.
KNOB 1 to 4 set reverb, delay, delay time and delay repeats; no synth, no song mode.
